confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rely on crowd-sourced Milan aggregators (Expatistan, MyLifeElsewhere) and an aperitivo guide, with mixed dates. Coffee and beer are medium confidence; the cocktail rests on a thin Expatistan sample; the wine glass has no direct per-glass source and is set equal to the beer anchor, with a cross-check against bottle prices of about EUR 10-11. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic general-knowledge estimates for a large northern Italian city in July. They are low confidence and were not checked against live listings. EUR to USD conversion uses an assumed rate of about 1.15 from general knowledge, not a verified source. FX: the RBA value is the 2026-03-20 USD observation from a search excerpt of the RBA exchange-rates page. It is about seven months old, and I could not verify a more recent RBA observation. No anchor depends on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Restaurant, coffee, beer, cocktail and wine anchors are based on Milan-specific aggregated price data. The wine glass uses the beer-relationship basis described above. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Milan city context, not from any searched listings.
